text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A for a gain felt satisfying, but I should decide whether to sell based on its outlook and my plan, not just the pleasure of locking in a profit.","I let the account fall substantially without trading; holding can be sensible, but I should review risk and position sizes rather than avoid decisions because selling at a loss feels painful.","A few months of results are not enough to judge my strategy. I should stay disciplined, avoid reacting to every decline, and make deliberate decisions that fit my long-term goals."]}
